newsitem.title: USA: Biopharmaceutics in cancer drug venture.
newsitem.headline: Biopharmaceutics in cancer drug venture.

text.p: Biopharmaceutics Inc said on Wednesday it had agreed to form a joint venture with Advanced Biological Systems Inc to commercialize Mitolactol, Biopharmaceutics' cancer drug.
Mitolactol is a cancer drug that holds Orphan Drug status for brain cancer and cervical cancer, Biopharmaceutics said. It has completed Phase III testing for both indications, the company said.
Advanced Biological will pay Biopharmaceutics $2,750,000 in cash and stock to participate in the joint venture, Biopharmaceutics said.

As part of the joint venture agreement, Advanced Biological will provide $1 million to the joint venture to cover all costs associated with the final development of Mitolactol and associated costs for all filings with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, the company said.
